scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = 'src/data'; const dest = 'dist/data'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'top-npm-packages.json'), path.join(dest, 'top-npm-packages.json')); }"
